approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: Start at the Snow Lakes Trailhead (paved, day-use permit required, ~4 miles up Icicle Creek Road from Leavenworth).

pins.name: Snow Lakes Trailhead
pins.note: Standard approach: Snow Lakes Trail #1553 (~4.2 mi up Icicle Creek Rd from US-2 in Leavenworth) into the Enchantment Lakes basin, then via Perfection Lake to Prusik Pass, traverse NW to the Druid Plateau, then to the summit block (roughly 13-14 mi and over 7,300 ft of gain one-way).
pins.directions: From US 2 on the west side of Leavenworth, turn south on Icicle Road and drive 4.2 miles to the paved Snow Lakes Trailhead lot at about 1,300 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park. Day trips need the free self-issued Enchantment permit at the trailhead; overnight stays from May 15 to Oct 31 need a quota permit.
